task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a PennyLane program with a QNode that applies RX(1.704) and RY(0.626) to one qubit and returns <Z>. Print the result and the analytic value cos(1.704)*cos(0.626). Write the full runnable code (all imports included); executing it should print the results.
